note: The input uSWID header supplies the header size used to locate the embedded coSWID payload.

code: payload = fu_input_stream_read_bytes(stream, offset + hdrsz, payloadsz, error);
note: The input-controlled payload bytes are read from offset plus hdrsz and passed as the coSWID CBOR data.

code: fw2 = fu_bytes_new_offset(payload, offset_tmp, payloadsz - offset_tmp, error);
note: The complete remaining uSWID payload becomes a child coSWID firmware blob.
A file hash CBOR array controlled by the input is routed to the hash parser.
The parser only checks that the second hash array element exists and misses the required check that it is a CBOR bytestring.
The non-bytestring second hash element is treated as a bytestring, causing libcbor to read bytestring fields from an object of the wrong type.
